title: PigADE app GPUI Linux dependency license metadata

method.graph: Traverse Cargo metadata resolve.nodes from resolve.root; this excludes packages not reachable from the app for the selected target.
method.licenseSource: Cargo package metadata license, license_file, source, repository, homepage, and documentation fields.
method.expressionHandling: Parse SPDX AND/OR/WITH with AND precedence over OR; normalize Cargo legacy slash-separated alternatives (for example MIT/Apache-2.0) to OR. A copyleft license is required by an expression if each allowed branch requires GPL/LGPL: AND requires either child; OR requires both children.
method.interpretationLimit: Metadata is a dependency inventory, not legal advice, a source-file license audit, or proof of redistribution compliance. OR alternatives are selectable according to declared expression; AND branches combine obligations. GPL/LGPL presence is flagged without proposing automatic removal.

otherCopyleftPackages.name: option-ext
otherCopyleftPackages.note: Declared expression is MPL-2.0; review separately as a weak/file-level copyleft license.

packages.name: linux-raw-sys
